detail: fn-own-sub-stored-octets under fn-owner-take-config (owner-host.lisp:2111, :2961) -> fn-ipp-injected-octets (injection-info-params.lisp:126) reads fn-ipp-complaints of the take-time config; a live config apply between enqueue and take changes what is stored. Main 10-13: the submission's decision should not depend on config read later.
title: a queued submission's staged octets read the complaints address from the CURRENT config at take (fn-owner-take-config), not the config it was admitted under
